newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel, tin fall, other base metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel, tin fall, other base metals steady.

text.p: Prices of tin and nickel fell on Monday in the absence of industrial demand while other metals were steady in sluggish trade, dealers said.
Tin lost 300 rupees to 31,100 rupees per quintal (100 kgs) and nickel shed 200 rupees to 36,300 rupees per quintal.
Copper and aluminium were steady at 13,750 rupees per quintal and 7,700 rupees per quintal respectively.
Dealers said there were enough stocks in the market which traders had imported earlier when their prices were relatively lower on the London Metals Exchange (LME).
"Now stockists are making fresh offerings. Market sentiment is quite subdued," said a dealer.
